scene postroomkaraoke1
: シャイニングスター綴れば、 夢に眠る幻が掌に降り注ぐ！
lines.zh: : シャイニングスター綴れば、 夢に眠る幻が掌に降り注ぐ！

lines.en: : 新たな世界へ-
lines.zh: : 新たな世界へ-

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke2
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: Room. Singing. Voices. So many voices.
lines.zh: 房间。歌声。人声。好多声音。

lines.en: Girl. Niki. Song. Here. Not here. Room. Last place.
lines.zh: 女孩。Niki。歌。在这里。不在这里。房间。上一个地方。

lines.en: Breathing. Help. Brain. Think. Help.
lines.zh: 呼吸。救命。大脑。思考。救命。

lines.en: : We’re...back {i}here{/i} again?...
lines.zh: : 我们……又回到「{i}这里{/i}」了？……

lines.en: : Ayane, stop talking or you’re going to miss your part! I won’t tolerate getting a low grade on one of the queen’s songs!
lines.zh: : Ayane，别说话了，不然你会错过你那部分！我可受不了在女王的歌上拿低分！

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke3

lines.zh: : Ami？……

lines.en: : I'll believe of my sensation、果てしない道の向こうで！
lines.zh: : I'll believe of my sensation、果てしない道の向こうで！

lines.en: Chair. Sat before. Halloween. Recent. Today? Now? Where?
lines.zh: 椅子。以前坐过。万圣节。不久前。今天？现在？在哪儿？

lines.en: Watermelon. Violin. Singing. Voices. So many voices.
lines.zh: 西瓜。小提琴。歌声。人声。好多声音。

lines.en: How to go back?
lines.zh: 要怎么回去？

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke4
: Is that...really you?...I’m not still dreaming, am I?
lines.zh: : 那……真的是你吗？……我不是还在做梦吧？

lines.en: : If you don’t start singing, I’m going to pinch you as hard as I can and you’ll find out the hard way whether you’re dreaming or-
lines.zh: : 你要是再不开口唱，我就用尽全力掐你一下，到时候你就知道是不是在做梦了——

lines.en: scene theendoftheworld45
scene theendoftheworld47
scene theendoftheworld48
scene postroomkaraoke5
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!! AMI!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！！！！ AMI！！！！！！！！

lines.en: : A-Ayane?! What the heck do you think you’re doing, jumping on me out of nowhere like that?! Let me go!
lines.zh: : A……Ayane？！你搞什么鬼，突然就扑上来？！放开我！

lines.en: : In a minute! I need this!
lines.zh: : 再等一分钟！我需要这个！

lines.en: : But why now?! We’ve been together the whole day and you’ve been totally normal so far!
lines.zh: : 可为什么是现在？！我们一整天都在一起，你之前一直都很正常啊！

lines.en: : The whole day? Have I been with you the whole day as well?
lines.zh: : 一整天？我也跟你们待了一整天吗？

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke6
: Seriously, what are you two up to?! Why are you being so weird and cryptic?! Just sing! I don’t even care if it’s bad anymore!
lines.zh: : 说真的，你们俩在搞什么？！为什么这么古怪又神神秘秘的？！快唱啊！我现在连你唱得烂不烂都不在乎了！

lines.en: : I’m so glad you’re safe...I was so worried.
lines.zh: : 你平安无事真是太好了……我担心死了。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke7

: About {i}what?{/i} And why did you have to wait until we were in the middle of my favorite song to start worrying? You could have worried all you want during Despacito and that would have been fine.
lines.zh: : 担心{i}什么{/i}？你为什么非得等到我最喜欢的歌唱到一半才开始担心？你可以在 Despacito 那首的时候担心个够，那都没关系。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke8
: Don’t worry about it! Just hug me back while I’m vulnerable and sad!
lines.zh: : 别管了！趁我现在脆弱又难过，你抱我就行！

lines.en: Girl. Look. Why girl? Reason. Eyes. At me. Hold. Want. Help.
lines.zh: 女孩。看。为什么是女孩？理由。眼睛。看着我。抱住。想要。救命。

lines.en: : You’re still like that?...
lines.zh: : 你还是那样？……

lines.en: : I’m still confused when it comes to all this apocalypse stuff, but...isn’t this the part where we’re supposed to go back to normal?
lines.zh: : 我对这些末日什么的还是一头雾水，不过……这不就是我们该恢复正常的部分了吗？

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke9
: Apocalypse stuff? What are you talking about now?
lines.zh: : 末日？你们现在又在说什么？

lines.en: : I’ve already said more to you than I’m apparently supposed to, so I’m just going to bite my tongue until Ayane stops crying into your shirt.
lines.zh: : 我已经跟你说了太多不该说的话了，所以我还是闭嘴，等 Ayane 哭够、不再往你衣服上抹眼泪吧。

lines.en: : Five more minutes!
lines.zh: : 再五分钟！

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke8
: Three and that’s my final offer!
lines.zh: : 三分钟，这是我的底线！

lines.en: Look again. Pity. Confusion.
lines.zh: 又看了一眼。怜悯。困惑。

lines.en: My hands. Shaking. Hers. Strong. Envy. Desire. Help.
lines.zh: 我的手。在抖。她的手。有力。嫉妒。渴望。救命。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke10
I’m beginning to think you never read the title of the Chapter 3 finale.
lines.zh: 我开始觉得，你根本没读过第三章终章的标题。

lines.en: You’re supposed to {i}smile,{/i} idiot.
lines.zh: 你该{i}笑{/i}，白痴。

lines.en: What you’re {i}not{/i} supposed to do is sit there quietly and attempt to {i}think.{/i} All that will do is detract from your purpose and trick you into believing you’re worth more than you are.
lines.zh: 你不该做的，是安静地坐在那儿试图{i}思考{/i}。那只会让你偏离使命，还骗自己以为自己比实际更有价值。

lines.en: I swear, you’re looking more like the world’s most unattractive Minato-girl with each passing heart palpitation. Just instead of money, you’re chasing after feelings and forbidden fruit.
lines.zh: 我发誓，随着你一次次心悸，你看起来越来越像世上最没魅力的港区女郎了。只不过你追的不是钱，是感情和禁果。

lines.en: Who’s going to want to fuck you if all you can do is sit there and feel sorry for yourself? Because I’ll be damned if you turn my chapter into some sappy, abstinent romp through an ocean of your tears.
lines.zh: 如果你只会坐在那儿自怨自艾，谁会想操你？我可绝不会让你把我的章节变成一场在你泪海里泡着的、禁欲又煽情的闹剧。

lines.en: scene thething2
do you have any idea how hard i had to work to get here? how long i had to wait? because i can guarantee you it would make the watermelon girl look like a tadpole gobbled up by its mother frog.
lines.zh: 你知道我费了多大劲才走到这一步吗？我等了多久？我可以向你保证，那会让西瓜女孩看起来像只被亲妈吞掉的蝌蚪。

lines.en: which, without beating around the bush, is kind of what she is in the first place. well...{i}was.{/i} whoops.
lines.zh: 而恕我直言，她本来就是那么个东西。好吧……曾经{i}是{/i}。哎呀。

lines.en: i’ll tell you what, you are clearly grieving. even someone like me who is incapable of {i}feeling{/i} can understand that.
lines.zh: 我跟你说，你显然在哀悼。连我这种没有{i}感情{/i}的人都看得懂。

lines.en: and as you have helped enable me to appear in a situation like this one, i will give you a little more time before i start pressing buttons again.
lines.zh: 而既然是你帮我才得以出现在这样的场景里，我就再给你一点时间，等我再开始按按钮。

lines.en: especially when i still feel as if you will begin to press them on your own in no time at all.
lines.zh: 尤其是我仍然觉得，你很快就会自己按下去的。

lines.en: Oh and if I start talking like this OR THIS AGAIN, please don’t pay it any mind. those in {s}our{/i} my position have our tendencies and preferences, but we’re all still part of the trinity and blend together sometimes.
lines.zh: 哦对了，如果我开始像这样、或者这样说话，请别在意。处在我这个位置上的存在都有各自的癖好与偏好，但我们同属三位一体，有时会混在一起。

lines.en: /////////////////EXECUTE LAUGH FUNCTION
I have one last thing to tell you before the next section of this scene begins, but I’ll try and make it quick since I’m looking forward to that part.
lines.zh: 在这一场景的下一段开始之前，我还有最后一件事要告诉你，不过我尽量长话短说，因为我挺期待那段。

lines.en: it would be in your best interest to follow in your mother’s footsteps.
lines.zh: 追随你母亲的脚步，才最符合你的利益。

lines.en: choose a god (ME) and follow it as far as your legs will take you, for doing so is the only way you’ll ever have a chance to see your girl again.
lines.zh: 选一位神（我），跟着它走到你双腿能及的尽头，因为只有这样，你才有机会再见到你的女孩。

lines.en: i’ll let {i}you{/i} decide which “girl” i am referring to.
lines.zh: 我指的「女孩」是哪个，由{i}你{/i}自己决定。

lines.en: beautiful things emerge from the dark, AKIRA.
lines.zh: 美好的事物自黑暗中诞生，AKIRA。

lines.en: i really am on your side.
lines.zh: 我真的站在你这边。

lines.en: you’ve just been staring straight forward for so long that you probably haven’t noticed.
lines.zh: 只是你直视前方太久，大概没注意到而已。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke11
: Hey, sorry. I couldn’t decide on a flavor of cheesecake, so I wound up buying all of them. And then eating all of them at the counter. And now I am here. Hello.
lines.zh: : 嘿，抱歉。我挑不出要哪种口味的芝士蛋糕，结果就把所有口味都买了。然后在柜台前全吃光了。现在我在这儿。你们好。

lines.en: : [[redacted]! Get Ayane off of me! She’s fallen in love and won’t accept that I’m only interested in Sensei! I mean...boys!
lines.zh: : [[redacted]！快把 Ayane 从我身上拉开！她坠入爱河了，还不肯接受我只对 Sensei 感兴趣！我是说……对男生！

lines.en: : Yeah, no.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不行。

lines.en: : [[redacted]...this might sound a little random, but...have you, by any chance-
lines.zh: : [[redacted]……这话可能有点突然，不过……你有没有，碰巧——

lines.en: : Whatever it is you’re about to ask, don’t. I feel like it’s going to be annoying and I’m not in the mood to deal with that.
lines.zh: : 不管你想问什么，别问。我觉得那会很烦，而我现在没心情应付。

lines.en: : Then, at least do Sensei the favor of-
lines.zh: : 那至少看在 Sensei 的份上——

lines.en: : Completely ignoring him for the rest of forever? Deal. Also, ew. Why does he look so...sad? He’s not supposed to have feelings. They make everyone uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 永远彻底无视他？成交。还有，呕。他为什么看起来那么……伤心？他不该有感情的。那会让所有人都不舒服。

lines.en: : He’s like that because of you, [[redacted].
lines.zh: : 他变成那样都是因为你，[[redacted]。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke12
: Me? What did {i}I{/i} do? I wasn’t even here until like thirty seconds ago. And if it’s about the cheesecake, the girl at the front desk said there {i}might{/i} be more. It’s just frozen and-
lines.zh: : 我？{i}我{/i}做了什么？我三十秒前才刚到这儿。如果是为了芝士蛋糕，前台的姑娘说也许还有。只是冻起来了，而且——

lines.en: : Wait, why do {i}you{/i} look like you’re about to cry now as well? What the fuck happened while I was gone?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}你{/i}为什么看起来也要哭了？我不在的时候到底发生了什么鬼事？

lines.en: : They’re {i}all{/i} acting weird! Well, except for Makoto. But she wears glasses and is basically just always weird, so she can’t be fairly compared to them.
lines.zh: : 他们{i}全都{/i}怪怪的！好吧，除了 Makoto。可她戴眼镜，本来就一直很怪，所以没法公平地跟他们比。

lines.en: None of this would have ever happened if Sana didn’t put a microphone in her vagina and Ayane and [[redacted] left the room and Ami died and Sana sung a song and then the world did a thing and
lines.zh: 如果 Sana 没把麦克风塞进她的阴道，如果 Ayane 和 [[redacted] 没离开房间，如果 Ami 没死，如果 Sana 没唱那首歌，如果世界没搞出那一出，这些事根本都不会发生，而且

lines.en: I got stuck in a room with a parrot and a bird and a bunch of different types of fish with smart lock technology (not on the fish) and a cereal rabbit and a thing in the trash and the shampoo bottle and
lines.zh: 我被困在一个房间里，和一只鹦鹉、一只鸟、一堆装了智能锁的鱼（鱼身上没装）、一只麦片兔、垃圾桶里的一个东西、还有那瓶洗发水，而且

lines.en: the most delicious hot pot in the entire world that I didn’t get to eat because there was a key but also there were other keys and a vase that kept respawning and Barbara was there and she likes movies and
lines.zh: 还有全世界最好吃的火锅我没吃上，因为有一把钥匙，可还有别的钥匙，还有个不断刷新的花瓶，Barbara 也在，她喜欢电影，而且

lines.en: I had cool action figures of some of the girls from my class that I carved out of plastic with my bare hands because I’m talented and I missed them but it was okay because Sana became my sex puppet since
lines.zh: 我有几个我班女生的超酷手办，是我用双手拿塑料雕出来的，因为我有才华，而且我想她们，不过没关系，因为 Sana 成了我的性玩偶，自从

lines.en: everyone else abandoned me and Ami died and I stopped wearing clothes because they felt weird and
lines.zh: 其他人都抛弃了我，Ami 死了，我不再穿衣服，因为衣服穿起来很怪，而且

lines.en: my computer gave me all the company I needed in the form of hardcore pornographic videos that I carefully critiqued and reviewed online thanks to my experience in the sexual field where I learned how to
lines.zh: 我的电脑给了我所需的一切陪伴——以限制级色情片的形式，而我凭借自己在性爱领域的经验，在网上仔细点评、写评测，还学会了怎么

lines.en: bring a girl to orgasm with little more than one finger and the promise that they are in good hands when in all actuality my hands are bad and no one should ever be in them or hold them or touch them or
lines.zh: 只用一根手指就让女孩高潮，还许诺说她们落到了可靠的手里，可实际上我那双手很糟，谁都不该落进它们手里、被它们握住、被它们触碰、或者

lines.en: do anything to them really because that’s just how bad they are.
lines.zh: 对它们做任何事，因为它们就是那么糟。

lines.en: This is all Sana’s fault and she will bear the burden of my rage once the world stops spinning and I stop wanting to throw up and I WANT TO FUCKING DIE HELP ME HELP ME HELP ME HELP ME.
lines.zh: 这一切都是 Sana 的错，等世界停止旋转、等我不再想吐，她就要承受我的怒火，我他妈想去死救救我救救我救救我救救我。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke13
nosheisntheresheisanillusionthisisntactuallyhappeningsheisgonethegirliloveisgoneletsalllistentothethemesong
lines.zh: nosheisntheresheisanillusionthisisntactuallyhappeningsheisgonethegirliloveisgoneletsalllistentothethemesong

lines.en: : Sensei...I’m so sorry...I’m {i}so{/i} sorry...I...I don’t even know where to begin...
lines.zh: : Sensei……对不起……我真的、{i}真的{/i}很抱歉……我……我甚至不知道从何说起……

lines.en: : Apologizing and getting emotional to the tune of deafening bubblegum J-pop feels weird as hell, not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 说句实话，在震耳欲聋的泡泡糖 J-pop 伴奏下道歉又情绪化，感觉诡异得要命。

lines.en: : Alexa, pause music.
lines.zh: : Alexa，暂停音乐。

lines.en: : Music paused.
lines.zh: : 音乐已暂停。

lines.en: : Sensei, what’s going on? You were fine just a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : Sensei，怎么了？几分钟前你还好好的。

lines.en: : It’s not because I picked Shining Star, is it? Did you and Niki get into a fight or something?
lines.zh: : 不是因为我选了 Shining Star 吧？你和 Niki 吵架了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I take it back. Put the music back on. This silence is even worse.
lines.zh: : 我收回刚才的话。把音乐放回去。这片沉默更糟。

lines.en: : I’m...still new to all of this. And I don’t think the things I have seen over the last hour have really hit me just yet, but...there’s surely {i}something{/i} we can do, isn’t there?
lines.zh: : 我……对这一切还很陌生。而且我觉得过去一小时看到的东西我还没有真正消化，不过……总有{i}什么{/i}我们能做的，对吧？

lines.en: : There’s no way the [[redacted] we knew is just-
lines.zh: : 我们认识的那个 [[redacted] 不可能就这么——

lines.en: : Jesus, guys. I was gone for fifteen minutes. Why is my appetite suddenly causing existential breakdowns for grown men and rich girls?
lines.zh: : 天啊，各位。我就走了十五分钟。我的食欲怎么突然让成年男人和富家小姐存在主义式地崩溃了？

lines.zh: 她不存在

lines.zh: 她不存在

lines.zh: 她不存在她不存在

lines.zh: 她不存在她不存在她不存在她不存在她不存在她不存在她不存在她不存在她不存在她不存在她不存在她不存在

lines.en: scene black
And without her, neither do I.
lines.zh: 而没有她，我也不存在。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke14
: Sensei, look at me. Breathe.
lines.zh: : Sensei，看着我。呼吸。

lines.en: : Everything is going to be okay. I’m here. I’ll protect you.
lines.zh: : 一切都会好起来的。我在这里。我会保护你。

lines.en: : And I’ll-
lines.zh: : 而我也可以——

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke15
: Let me handle this. You can just sit there and look pretty.
lines.zh: : 让我来处理。你就坐在那儿负责好看就行。

lines.en: : But, Ami...I know why Sensei is-
lines.zh: : 可是，Ami……我知道 Sensei 为什么会——

lines.en: : With all due respect, Ayane, you don’t know anything. And now probably isn’t the right time to start pretending you do, okay?
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，Ayane，你什么都不知道。而现在大概也不是开始装知道的合适时机，好吗？

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke16
: Ami!
lines.zh: : Ami！

lines.en: : Sorry about that, Sensei. Just focus on the sound of my voice, okay?
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，Sensei。只要专注于我的声音就好，好吗？

lines.en: : Block everything else out.
lines.zh: : 把其他一切都屏蔽掉。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke17
: Good. Now, think back to when you were young.
lines.zh: : 很好。现在，回想你小的时候。

lines.en: : Younger than I am now — when the average seat in an average restaurant was high enough that your feet would dangle off the ground when sitting on one.
lines.zh: : 比我现在还小——那时候普通餐馆里普通的椅子都高到你坐上去脚会悬空。

lines.en: : There was a glass cabinet in the tatami room of your old family home. Inside that cabinet was a large, leatherbound book with a gold inlay pressed upon the perimeter.
lines.zh: : 在你老家那间榻榻米房间里，有一个玻璃柜。柜子里放着一本很大的皮面书，四周压着金色的镶边。

lines.en: : Do you remember what was inside that book?
lines.zh: : 你还记得那本书里放着什么吗？

lines.en: : It was a flower. A {i}sunflower.{/i} Your {i}favorite{/i} flower. And every time something bad happened, you would pluck a petal from its receptacle.
lines.zh: : 是一朵花。一朵{i}向日葵{/i}。你{i}最爱{/i}的花。每次发生了不好的事，你就会从它的花托上摘下一片花瓣。

lines.en: : And even when the scent faded, the sensation of that dry, paper yellow appendage brought you a sense of calm nothing else ever had.
lines.zh: : 而即便香气散去，那片干枯如纸的黄色附属物所带来的触感，仍能给你别的东西从未给过的平静。

lines.en: : Nothing until me, that is.
lines.zh: : 至少在我出现之前，什么都没有。

lines.en: : Now, whenever you are sad, you can take a piece of Ami.
lines.zh: : 现在，只要你难过，就可以拿走 Ami 的一部分。

lines.en: : I don’t care which one.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎是哪一部分。

lines.en: : If you ask for my fingers, I’ll cut them off one by one until you’re satisfied.
lines.zh: : 你要我的手指，我就一根一根切下来，直到你满意为止。

lines.en: : If you ask for my tongue, I’ll let you bite it until I bleed to death.
lines.zh: : 你要我的舌头，我就让你咬，直到我失血而死。

lines.en: : And if you ask for my eyes, I’ll spoon them out and live the rest of my life in the dark.
lines.zh: : 你要我的眼睛，我就把它们挖出来，在黑暗中度过余生。

lines.en: : I offer these things up because I love you more than anyone else ever could and anyone else ever {i}will.{/i} And I will remain by your side no matter how lost you become.
lines.zh: : 我献上这些，是因为我爱你胜过任何人能做到的、也胜过任何人将来能做到的。而无论你迷失到什么地步，我都{i}会{/i}留在你身边。

lines.en: : I will always be a light that you can follow. I will always be someone you can trust.
lines.zh: : 我永远会是一盏你可以追随的光。我永远会是一个你可以信任的人。

lines.en: : Don’t you want to be happy?
lines.zh: : 你不想幸福吗？

lines.en: : If you do, follow the light. Let me absorb and absolve you of those terrible thoughts you think.
lines.zh: : 如果想，就追随那道光。让我吸收并赦免你脑子里那些可怕的想法。

lines.en: : I am all you will ever need.
lines.zh: : 我永远是你唯一需要的一切。

lines.en: : And when life gets too hard to simply live, all you have to do is let me live it for you.
lines.zh: : 而当生活艰难到活不下去的时候，你只需要让我替你活下去。

lines.en: : No one else can do that, you know.
lines.zh: : 别人可做不来，你知道吗。

lines.en: : I’ve been with you the longest.
lines.zh: : 我陪你的时间最长。

lines.en: : I know things about you no one else does.
lines.zh: : 我知道一些别人不知道的、关于你的事。

lines.en: : You know things about me that no one else does.
lines.zh: : 你也知道一些别人不知道的、关于我的事。

lines.en: : We can exist for each other in our own make-believe tatami room, and find a new book to lock inside a special cabinet.
lines.zh: : 我们可以为彼此而存在，在我们那间虚构的榻榻米房间里，再找一本新书锁进一个特别的柜子。

lines.en: : And if we can’t find a book, I’m sure there will be something else worth locking up.
lines.zh: : 如果找不到书，我相信也会有别的值得锁起来的东西。

lines.en: : There are so many beautiful things in this world, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这世上有那么多美好的东西，Sensei。

lines.en: : How do you feel about starting a collection?
lines.zh: : 你觉得开始一段收藏怎么样？

lines.en: : On the count of three, you will open your eyes.
lines.zh: : 数到三，你就会睁开眼睛。

lines.en: : And then-
lines.zh: : 然后——

lines.en: : You will follow me to safety.
lines.zh: : 你会跟着我，去往安全的地方。

: Home.
lines.zh: : 回家。

lines.en: : Home it is. Let’s go home.
lines.zh: : 那就回家。我们回家吧。

lines.en: : Sensei, are you sure that-
lines.zh: : Sensei，你确定——

lines.en: : {i}Stop talking, Ayane.{/i} You’re just going to overstimulate him and he’s already in a bad place right now.
lines.zh: : {i}别说了，Ayane。{/i}你只会让他过度受刺激，而他现在的状况已经够糟了。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke19
: At least let me come with you! I can’t just leave him behind when I know what he’s going through is-
lines.zh: : 至少让我跟你一起去！我知道他正在经历什么，我不能就这么把他丢下——

lines.en: : Sure you can! And you will because it’s my job to take care of him.
lines.zh: : 你当然能！而且你会的，因为照顾他是我的职责。

lines.en: : Ami!
lines.zh: : Ami！

lines.en: : Present.
lines.zh: : 本人在。

lines.en: : Ami, Sensei is just as important to me as he is to-
lines.zh: : Ami，Sensei 对我来说，和对你来说一样重要——

lines.en: : Stay.
lines.zh: : 留下。

lines.en: scene postroomkaraoke20
: Ami can help.
lines.zh: : Ami 能帮上忙。

lines.en: : You can not.
lines.zh: : 你不行。
